purpose: Generic UI behavior checks across multiple task states, proving shell cleanup preserves behavior beyond the known test cases.

generic_checks.shape: /coding loaded with an unseen task state
generic_checks.assertion: renders CodingCockpitShell with identical behavior to baseline

generic_checks.shape: feature flag unset on an unseen task state
generic_checks.assertion: behavior identical to pre-F7 (flag default = current)

generic_checks.shape: timeline/receipt/debug component rendered from each shell on an unseen task
generic_checks.assertion: shared component produces identical output; shell-specific props honored

generic_checks.shape: each of the 3 shells imported in isolation
canonical shell across idle / running / awaiting-approval / failed states
generic_checks.assertion: state transitions and rendered output unchanged vs baseline

generation_rule: unseen task states are generated by varying task payload/phase without reusing fixture task IDs; the invariant is identical UI behavior under default flags
